clips.send: Wind power. Moving air spins turbines. Wind spins the giant blades, which turn a generator inside the nacelle at the top of the tower. Wind exists because the Sun heats Earth unevenly, so wind energy is really solar energy too. Power rises quickly with wind speed. Below about 3 m/s the blades barely turn. Try the Wind slider!

clips.send: Biomass. Energy stored in living things. Wood, crop waste, manure and fuels made from corn or sugarcane (ethanol) can be burned for heat or electricity. Plants store the Sun’s energy through photosynthesis, so biomass is stored solar energy. It is renewable only if we replant as fast as we use it. Burning it still releases CO2 and smoke.

clips.send: Oil (petroleum). Liquid fossil fuel from ancient sea life. Oil formed from tiny ocean plants and animals (plankton) buried in seafloor mud millions of years ago, then heated and pressed. It seeps upward through rock until it is trapped under a cap rock. Wells and pump jacks bring it to the surface. Oil is refined into gasoline, diesel and jet fuel, and is used to make plastics. Spills harm oceans and wildlife.

clips.send: Hydroelectric power. Falling water spins turbines. A dam stores water in a reservoir. When water rushes down through the dam, it spins turbines connected to generators. Rain refills the reservoir, and rain comes from the water cycle, which the Sun drives. Hydropower is reliable day and night, but dams flood valleys and block fish such as salmon from swimming upstream.

clips.send: Solar power. Sunlight, electricity. Solar panels (photovoltaic cells) turn sunlight directly into electricity, with no moving parts and no smoke. They only work when the Sun shines: nothing at night and less on cloudy days. Drag the Time slider and watch the output. Solar water heaters on roofs use sunlight to heat water directly.

clips.send: Natural gas. Gaseous fossil fuel, often found with oil. Natural gas (mostly methane) forms the same way as oil and collects above it in the trap, because gas is lighter. It heats homes, fuels stoves and runs power plants. Pipelines carry it across the country. It releases about half the CO2 of coal when burned, but methane that leaks is a powerful greenhouse gas.

clips.send: Geothermal energy. Heat from inside Earth. Deep underground, rock is hot from Earth’s internal heat. Wells pump water down and bring steam up to spin turbines. It works best near volcanoes and plate boundaries, as in Iceland, which gets about a quarter of its electricity this way. Geothermal heat pumps can also heat and cool homes almost anywhere.

clips.send: Coal. Fossil fuel from ancient swamp plants. Coal formed from plants in swamps about 300 million years ago that were buried, squeezed and heated over millions of years. Power plants burn coal to boil water; the steam spins turbines. See the black coal seam in the rock layers. Burning coal releases the most CO2 of any fuel, plus pollution that causes smog and acid rain. Mining scars the land.

clips.send: Your town: saving energy. The cheapest energy is the energy you don’t use. Conservation means using less: turn off lights, unplug chargers, walk, bike or share rides. Efficiency means getting the same job done with less energy: LED bulbs use about 75 percent less electricity than old bulbs. Reduce, reuse, recycle: making new things from recycled aluminum uses about 95 percent less energy than making them from raw ore.

clips.send: Nuclear power. Splitting uranium atoms. In the reactor, uranium atoms split (nuclear fission) and release huge amounts of heat, which boils water to spin turbines. It makes no CO2 while running, and a small amount of fuel makes a lot of energy. It is nonrenewable because uranium is a mined metal that will run out. The used fuel stays radioactive for thousands of years and must be stored safely.

clips.send: 风能。流动的空气转动风力机。风吹动巨大的叶片，带动塔顶机舱里的发电机发电。风的形成是因为太阳对地球的加热不均匀，所以风能其实也来自太阳能。风速越大，发电量增加得越快；风速低于约 3 米/秒时叶片几乎不转。试试风速滑块！

clips.send: 地热能。来自地球内部的热量。地下深处的岩石因地球内部的热量而很热。人们把水注入地下，再把蒸汽引上来推动汽轮机发电。在火山和板块边界附近效果最好，例如冰岛约四分之一的电力来自地热。地源热泵几乎在任何地方都可以为房屋供暖和制冷。

clips.send: 你的小镇：节约能源。最便宜的能源是没用掉的能源。节约就是少用：随手关灯、拔掉充电器，步行、骑车或拼车出行。提高效率就是用更少的能源办同样的事：LED 灯比老式灯泡省电约 百分之75。减少、再利用、回收：用回收的铝制造新产品，比用铝矿石生产节省约 百分之95 的能源。

clips.send: 石油。由古代海洋生物形成的液态化石燃料。石油是几百万年前埋在海底淤泥中的微小海洋生物（浮游生物）经过加热和挤压形成的。它在岩层中向上渗透，直到被盖层封住。油井和抽油机把它抽到地面。石油被提炼成汽油、柴油和航空煤油，还用来制造塑料。石油泄漏会危害海洋和野生动物。

clips.send: 天然气。气态化石燃料，常与石油伴生。天然气（主要成分是甲烷）和石油的形成方式相同，因为更轻，所以聚集在储油构造中石油的上方。它用于家庭取暖、燃气灶和发电厂，通过管道输送到全国各地。燃烧时排放的二氧化碳约为煤的一半，但泄漏的甲烷是一种很强的温室气体。

clips.send: 煤。由古代沼泽植物形成的化石燃料。煤是大约 3 亿年前沼泽中的植物被埋藏后，经过数百万年的挤压和加热形成的。发电厂燃烧煤把水烧开，蒸汽推动汽轮机发电。看看岩层中黑色的煤层。燃烧煤释放的二氧化碳是所有燃料中最多的，还会产生导致雾霾和酸雨的污染物；采煤会破坏土地。

clips.send: 生物质能。储存在生物体内的能量。木材、农作物废料、粪便，以及用玉米或甘蔗制成的燃料（乙醇），都可以燃烧来供热或发电。植物通过光合作用储存太阳能，所以生物质能是储存起来的太阳能。只有种植的速度跟得上使用的速度，它才是可再生的；燃烧它仍会释放二氧化碳和烟尘。

clips.send: 核能。分裂铀原子。在反应堆中，铀原子发生分裂（核裂变），释放出大量热量，把水烧开推动汽轮机。运行时不排放二氧化碳，少量燃料就能产生大量能量。它属于不可再生能源，因为铀是开采出来的金属，终会用完；用过的核燃料数千年内都有放射性，必须安全储存。

clips.send: 太阳能。阳光，电能。太阳能电池板（光伏电池）把阳光直接转化为电能，没有运动部件，也不冒烟。只有太阳照射时才能发电：夜里不发电，阴天发电少。拖动时间滑块，观察发电量。屋顶上的太阳能热水器直接利用阳光加热水。
clips.text: 太阳能. 阳光 → 电能. 太阳能电池板（光伏电池）把阳光直接转化为电能，没有运动部件，也不冒烟。. 只有太阳照射时才能发电：夜里不发电，阴天发电少。拖动时间滑块，观察发电量。. 屋顶上的太阳能热水器直接利用阳光加热水。

clips.send: 水力发电。落下的水推动水轮机。水坝把水拦在水库里。水从坝内冲下时推动水轮机，带动发电机发电。降雨不断补充水库，而降雨来自太阳驱动的水循环。水电日夜都很稳定，但水坝会淹没河谷，并阻挡鲑鱼等鱼类洄游。
